title: N.P. Ponnuswami v. Returning Officer, Namakkal

content.caseIdentity: N.P. Ponnuswami v. Returning Officer, Namakkal, 1952 SCR 218
content.holding: Article 329(b) bars courts from interfering with or stalling an ongoing election under Article 226; post-result Election Petition before the High Court is the sole remedy.
content.relevance: Foundational authority on non-interference by courts in ongoing elections.
